instruction: Set GIMP to show layer boundaries by default.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling layer boundary display by default in GIMP preferences. The evaluator checks the gimprc configuration file for the default-show-layer-boundary parameter with value yes. Uses existing check_config_status metric and gimp_config_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly retrieves GIMP gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric logic correctly parses gimprc file (Lisp-style format) and checks for key-value pairs
Expected key 'default-show-layer-boundary' with value 'yes' is semantically correct for enabling layer boundaries in GIMP
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure settings are written to gimprc file
Evaluator provides complete coverage - verifies the exact requirement in the instruction
Data flow is correct: getter returns config file path, metric checks key-value in that file
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor typo in expected.rules: 'type:' (with colon) should be 'type' - though this doesn't affect functionality since check_config_status metric doesn't use this field
